mapper.select: SELECT station_code stationCode,MAX(station_name) name,MAX(country) country,MAX(province) province,MAX(city) city, MIN(observation_date) firstDate,MAX(observation_date) lastDate,COUNT(*) observations FROM platform_raw_observation WHERE dataset_id=#{datasetId} GROUP BY station_code ORDER BY station_code LIMIT 200
SELECT * FROM platform_analysis_run WHERE dataset_id=#{datasetId} ORDER BY result_version DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_analysis_run WHERE dataset_id=#{datasetId} AND result_version=#{version})

choose.otherwise: observation_year `year`,region_level level,country,province,city,district,metric, avg_days avgDays,min_days minDays,max_days maxDays,median_days medianDays,station_count stationCount
